# Verify that go list -export (with golistexportnewformat) and go list -compiled
# work for cgo binding packages without a C compiler.

env origGOEXPERIMENT=$GOEXPERIMENT
env GOEXPERIMENT=$GOEXPERIMENT,runtimecgopurego,cgobindings,golistexportnewformat
[!GOEXPERIMENT:cgobindings] skip
[GOOS:plan9] skip
[GOOS:js] skip
[GOOS:wasip1] skip
[GOOS:openbsd] [GOARCH:ppc64] skip
[GOOS:freebsd] [GOARCH:riscv64] skip
[GOOS:linux] [GOARCH:sparc64] skip

# Build the pure-Go verifier under the host GOEXPERIMENT in parallel so it
# reuses the warm standard library GOCACHE instead of rebuilding go/importer
# under cgobindings.
env GOEXPERIMENT=$origGOEXPERIMENT
env CGO_ENABLED=0
go build -o q$GOEXE q.go &

env GOEXPERIMENT=$origGOEXPERIMENT,runtimecgopurego,cgobindings,golistexportnewformat
env CGO_ENABLED=bindings
[!GOOS:windows] env CC=/bin/false

# In a cgo binding package, the files generated by cgo -binding replace
# the package's Go files.
go list -export -json b.go
cp stdout out.json

# Verify that CompiledGoFiles[len(GoFiles)] is _cgo_gotypes.go for cgo binding
# packages (relied on by x/tools/go/packages TypecheckCgo).
go list -compiled -f '{{println (len .GoFiles) (len .CgoFiles) (len .CompiledGoFiles)}}{{index .CompiledGoFiles 1}}' b.go b_plain.go
stdout '^1 1 3$'
cp stdout compiled.txt

wait
exec ./q$GOEXE out.json compiled.txt
stdout 'func\(\w+ \*byte\) int32'

-- b.go --
package p

import "C"

//cgo:func puts puts libc
func puts(s *byte) int32

var V = puts

-- b_plain.go --
package p

var Plain = 1

-- q.go --
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/importer"
	"go/token"
	"io"
	"log"
	"os"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	// This is a minimal output of go list -export -json.
	type output struct {
		ImportPath string
		Export     string
	}
	var out output
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &out); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	fset := token.NewFileSet()
	imp := importer.ForCompiler(fset, "gc", func(path string) (io.ReadCloser, error) {
		if path != out.ImportPath {
			log.Fatalf("unexpected import: %q", path)
		}
		return os.Open(out.Export)
	})
	pkg, err := imp.Import(out.ImportPath)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	fmt.Println(pkg.Scope().Lookup("V").Type())

	compiled, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[2])
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	lines := strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(string(compiled)), "\n")
	if len(lines) < 2 {
		log.Fatalf("unexpected compiled.txt:\n%s", compiled)
	}
	cgoTypes, err := os.ReadFile(strings.TrimSpace(lines[1]))
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
	if !strings.Contains(string(cgoTypes), "_cgo_runtime_cgocall") {
		log.Fatalf("CompiledGoFiles[1] does not look like _cgo_gotypes.go:\n%s", cgoTypes)
	}
}
